metric_definitions.instantaneous_entry_rate: Fraction of all episodes that enter the terminal tolerance set at least once.
metric_definitions.strict_success_rate: Fraction of all episodes satisfying the terminal tolerances for five consecutive control steps.
metric_definitions.first_entry_false_positive_rate: Among episodes with at least one terminal entry, fraction whose first entry is not maintained for five consecutive steps.
metric_definitions.pre_success_exit_rate: Among strictly successful episodes, fraction that exit the terminal tolerance set after first entry and before eventual strict success.
metric_definitions.instant_only_failure_rate: Fraction of all episodes that enter the terminal region at least once but never achieve strict success.
